--accent: Scoped accent fill — re-points to --primary by default, overridable per zone.
--accent-focus-field: Field focus glow for scoped-accent controls.
--accent-focus-ring: Focus ring shadow for scoped-accent controls.
--accent-muted: Scoped accent, muted tint for subtle fills.
--accent-muted-strong: Scoped accent, muted-strong tint for subtle fills.
--accent-strong: Scoped accent, stronger contrast variant (text on light surfaces).
--accent-subtitle: Scoped accent, low-emphasis tint (subtitles, soft backgrounds).
--accent-surface-tint: Scoped accent surface tint (page/panel background wash).
--auth-card-w: Card width in ds-auth-layout (default 420px). NOT a --ds-* token and deliberately so: it is the shared width the card and the masthead row both cap against, so the wordmark cannot outgrow the card. Retune the card alone with --ds-auth-layout-card-max-width.
--border-width-strong: Radio dot, slider thumb, tabs underline, dropzone dash.
--btn-focus-z: Button focus ring stacking order (defaults to --layer-raised).
--btn-group-focus-z: Button group focus ring stacking order, above siblings (2).
--btn-group-overlap: -1px — collapses adjacent borders between grouped buttons.
--bulk-bar-offset: 16px — bulk action toolbar sticky offset from container bottom.
--calendar-bar-inset-y: Calendar event bar vertical inset (8px, showcase).
--calendar-cell-min: Calendar day-cell min size (defaults to --hit-cozy, showcase).
--chart-area-opacity: Opacity of a line series' area fill (0.16).
--chart-dim-opacity: Opacity a chart mark drops to while another is singled out.
--chart-divergent--1: Diverging chart scale colour, negative step -1.
--chart-divergent--2: Diverging chart scale colour, negative step -2.
--chart-divergent--3: Diverging chart scale colour, negative extreme (step -3).
--chart-divergent-0: Diverging chart scale colour, neutral midpoint.
--chart-divergent-1: Diverging chart scale colour, positive step 1.
--chart-divergent-2: Diverging chart scale colour, positive step 2.
--chart-divergent-3: Diverging chart scale colour, positive extreme (step 3).
--chart-dot-radius-active: Chart line/scatter series dot radius, active/hover state (6px).
--chart-legend-dot: Chart legend swatch dot size (defaults to --icon-2xs, showcase).
--chart-line-width-bold: Chart line series stroke width, emphasised (3px).
--chart-threshold-band-opacity: Fill opacity of a reference band.
--check-glyph-lg: 24px — fixed box size for .size-lg checkbox (not density-scaled).
--check-glyph-sm: 14px — fixed box size for .size-sm checkbox (not density-scaled).
--check-tick-size: 12px — checkmark glyph inside the checked box.
--cmdk-list-maxh: Command palette list max height (aliases --popover-maxh to stay in sync).
--col-cap-content: Maximum content column for app layouts.
--compare-dt-w: Comparison table data column width (90px, showcase).
--date-picker-cell-gap: Date Picker day cell gap geometry (defaults to --space-0-5).
--date-picker-nav-size: Date Picker nav button hit-area size (defaults to --hit-xs).
--dl-spec-value-min-w: Description-list narrowest value beside the label before the list stacks (14rem).
--dodont-stage-minh: Do/don't example stage min height (100px, showcase).
--ds-accordion-body-padding: Panel body padding, as the CSS shorthand (default `var(--space-2) var(--space-4) var(--space-4)`: 8px top, 16px sides, 16px bottom).
--ds-accordion-header-gap: Space between the header label, a projected [badge] and the chevron (default --space-2).
--ds-accordion-header-hover-text-color: Header label colour on hover. Defaults to the resting --ds-accordion-header-text-color, so nothing moves until it is set.
--ds-accordion-header-padding: Header padding, as the CSS shorthand (default `var(--space-3) var(--space-4)`: 12px vertical, 16px horizontal).
--ds-alert-bg-color: Alert surface fill (defaults to info tint; severity re-points it).
--ds-alert-close-icon-color-hover: Alert dismiss icon colour on hover.
--ds-alert-enter-keyframes: Alert entrance @keyframes (default ds-fade-in, fading in where the alert stands).
--ds-alert-enter-offset: How far the alert travels in, and from where: negative means it settles down from above. The default ds-fade-in does not travel, so this applies once --ds-alert-enter-keyframes names a preset that does, such as ds-slide-in (default 2px).
--ds-app-layout-content-max-width: Max width of the centred content wrapper (none by default — full width).
--ds-app-layout-height: Host height, pinned to the viewport so only the content region scrolls (defaults to 100dvh).
--ds-app-layout-padding-x: Content region horizontal padding (defaults to --space-6); right side nets out --ds-scrollbar-width.
--ds-app-layout-rail-bg-color: Rail background while it is an overlay below the lg breakpoint (defaults to --surface-overlay); above lg the rail is in the layout and inherits its own component's surface.
--ds-app-layout-rail-shadow: Rail elevation while it is an overlay below the lg breakpoint (defaults to --ds-elevation-modal).
--ds-app-layout-scrim-color: Scrim behind the rail overlay below the lg breakpoint (defaults to --scrim).
--ds-auth-layout-brand-max-height: Cap for a logo projected into [brand] (defaults to the tile size, --ds-auth-layout-mark-size, so a logo matches the letter-mark it replaces). Set none to leave the logo unconstrained.
--ds-auth-layout-brand-name-font-size: Wordmark size beside the tile (defaults to --font-size-h5, 18px, as in ds-sidenav).
--ds-auth-layout-card-max-width: Measure of the auth column — the card, and with it the tagline and support line (defaults to --auth-card-w, 420px).
--ds-auth-layout-gap: Space between masthead, card and support footer. Defaults to a clamp that compresses on a short viewport (16px…32px, 32px at an 800px-tall viewport); a fixed value opts out.
--ds-auth-layout-mark-bg-color: Letter-mark tile fill (defaults to --accent — the same default as the sidenav's mark, but a separate hook, so retinting the mark means setting both).
--ds-auth-layout-mark-font-size: Letter-mark glyph size inside the tile (defaults to --font-size-m, 16px).
--ds-auth-layout-mark-radius: Letter-mark tile radius (defaults to --ds-radius-control). Squaring a brand with --ds-radius-control: 0 reaches this tile too; set this to keep it rounded independently.
--ds-auth-layout-mark-size: Letter-mark tile size (defaults to --sidenav-logo-size, 28px, the sidenav's tile).
--ds-auth-layout-min-height: Host height the centring works against (defaults to 100dvh); set it to 100% to embed the layout in a box that is not the page.
--ds-auth-layout-padding-block: Block padding around the auth column. Defaults to a clamp that COMPRESSES on a short viewport (16px…40px, reaching 40px at an 800px-tall viewport) so the layout's own furniture is never what pushes a card into scrolling; set a fixed value to opt out of the compression.
--ds-autocomplete-border-color-focus: Autocomplete field border colour on focus.
--ds-autocomplete-border-color-hover: Autocomplete field border colour on hover (default --ds-field-border-color-hover, then --border-strong).
--ds-autocomplete-focus-shadow: Autocomplete focus ring (inherits shared field focus shadow).
--ds-autocomplete-panel-bg-color: Autocomplete dropdown panel fill (default --surface-overlay). The panel is portaled, so set it on the host - a global rule against the pane cannot see the host override.
--ds-autocomplete-panel-max-height: Autocomplete dropdown panel max height before it scrolls (default --picker-maxh, shared with ds-multi-select). Forwarded onto the portaled pane on open.
--ds-autocomplete-panel-radius: Autocomplete dropdown panel corner radius (default --ds-radius-panel). Forwarded onto the portaled pane on open.
--ds-autocomplete-placeholder-color: Placeholder colour of the filter input (default --ds-field-placeholder-color, then --text-tertiary - the same as ds-input; before this the placeholder was the browser's own grey).
--ds-autocomplete-text-color: Colour of the typed text and of the picked value shown in the trigger (default --ds-field-text-color, then --text-primary).
--ds-avatar-group-overflow-label-color: Avatar group "+N" overflow badge text colour.
--ds-badge-font-size: Label size (default --font-size-xs). A count badge re-resolves the same token with a --font-size-2xs default, so one value set on the host reaches both forms.
--ds-badge-white-space: Label wrapping (default nowrap). Set to normal for a badge in a narrow, fixed-layout table column, where nowrap clips the label.
--ds-banner-body-font-size: Size of the banner's projected body text (default --font-size-s, matching the title). Declared rather than inherited, so a 16px page context cannot render the body larger than its own title.
--ds-banner-enter-keyframes: Banner entrance @keyframes (default ds-fade-in, fading in where the banner stands).
--ds-banner-enter-offset: How far the banner travels in, and from where: negative means it settles down from above. The default ds-fade-in does not travel, so this applies once --ds-banner-enter-keyframes names a preset that does, such as ds-slide-in (default 4px).
--ds-banner-title-font-size: Size of the banner's title (default --font-size-s, the same as the body). compact does not change it, so a 12px strip is this token plus --ds-banner-body-font-size on the host.
--ds-bar-chart-child-fill-opacity: Child-row bar opacity in a group (default 0.55).
--ds-bar-chart-divider-color: Dashed divider above a detached row (default --border-default).
--ds-bar-chart-target-color: Fill of the target tick a ds-bar-chart row draws across its bar (default --text-primary).
--ds-bar-chart-target-overhang: How far the target tick runs past the bar at each end (default 3px).
--ds-bar-chart-target-width: Thickness of that target tick; it also sets the tick's corner radius and the half-width shift that centres it on the target value (default 2px).
--ds-bar-chart-track-color: Unfilled part of a ds-bar-chart bar (default --chart-grid-line-color).
--ds-bar-radius: Corner radius of a ds-bar track and its fill (default --radius-pill). The fill follows the track, so a squared track never shows a rounded fill inside it.
--ds-bottom-sheet-enter-duration: Bottom-sheet entrance duration (default --duration-base); the scrim uses --duration-fast until this is set.
--ds-bottom-sheet-enter-keyframes: Bottom-sheet entrance @keyframes (default ds-slide-edge-in — travel with no fade).
--ds-bottom-sheet-enter-scale: Start scale if the sheet enters with ds-scale-in (default 0.96).
--ds-bottom-sheet-leave-duration: Bottom-sheet close duration (default --duration-base); the scrim uses --duration-fast until this is set.
--ds-bottom-sheet-leave-keyframes: Exit keyframes name for the sheet panel (default ds-slide-edge-out). The scrim keeps its own fade.
--ds-breadcrumbs-current-label-max-width: Width at which the current crumb clips to an ellipsis (default 32ch).
--ds-breadcrumbs-label-max-width: Width at which a link crumb clips to an ellipsis (default 16ch).
--ds-breadcrumbs-padding: Padding of every crumb, the current one included (default 0).
--ds-breadcrumbs-radius: Crumb corner radius, also the focus ring's (default --radius-sm).
--ds-button-bg-color: Surface fill — variants re-point the default.
--ds-button-bg-color-active: Active/pressed fill — derived from the resolved bg unless set.
--ds-button-bg-color-disabled: Disabled fill. Per variant: a flat pale tint of the accent for solid; color-mix(fill 28%, surface-disabled) for tonal; transparent for ghost, outline and text.
--ds-button-bg-color-hover: Hover fill — derived from the resolved bg unless set.
--ds-button-border-color-active: Border colour while pressed. Defaults to --ds-button-border-color-hover, so the edge holds through the press until this is set.
--ds-button-border-color-disabled: Disabled border — a pale tint of the accent for solid, color-mix(border 55%, surface-disabled) for outline.
--ds-button-border-color-hover: Border colour on hover. Defaults to the resting --ds-button-border-color (the outline variant's own border included), so nothing moves until this is set.
--ds-button-border-width: The button border's WIDTH, where --ds-button-border-color is its colour. Defaults to --border-width-default; set it rather than redefining that scale step for a subtree.
--ds-button-font-family: The button label's family. Defaults to --font-sans; set it where buttons follow the heading face rather than the body one, instead of re-pointing --font-sans inside the component.
--ds-button-font-size: Label size. Overrides the size class, so one value holds across sm/md/lg.
--ds-button-height: Button height, overriding the size class. Set with --ds-button-padding-y for a box sized by its padding instead.
--ds-button-label-color-active: Label colour while pressed. Defaults to --ds-button-label-color.
--ds-button-label-color-disabled: Disabled label — ONE recipe for every variant, oklch(from accent 70% 0.035 h). 70% because the old 58%/52% pair sat where a saturated accent already is, so a disabled coloured button barely differed from its live self.
--ds-button-label-color-hover: Label colour under the cursor. Defaults to --ds-button-label-color, so a button that does not set it does not change on hover.
--ds-button-line-height: The button label's line height. Defaults to --line-height-flat.
--ds-button-padding-y: Vertical padding — 0 by default, since height is fixed; pair with height:auto styling for a padding-sized button.
--ds-button-pressed-shadow: Opt-in pressed halo (default off) — set to re-enable a ring on press.
--ds-button-shadow: Resting shadow — `none` by default, so a button carries one only where an app asks. Focus and pressed keep their own hooks and still win while those states are on.
--ds-button-shadow-hover: Shadow on hover. Falls back to `--ds-button-shadow`, so setting the resting one alone keeps the button steady under the pointer.
--ds-card-overflow: Overflow of the card's own rounded box — `visible` by default. Set `clip` where a full-bleed child (an image, a footer strip) would otherwise paint its square corners over the card's radius; `clip` rather than `hidden` keeps it from becoming a scroll container. A clipped card also cuts the focus ring of any child at its edge, so pair it with `data-focus="inset"` on the card.
--ds-chart-annotation-color: Fill of a dsSeriesAnnotation label, the reading a chart prints next to a mark so a screenshot carries what a tooltip would (default --text-primary).
--ds-chart-annotation-font-size: Type size of those annotation labels (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-font-size, so a label sits with the chart's furniture rather than shouting over the marks).
--ds-chart-annotation-halo-color: Colour of the halo painted under an annotation label so it survives over a line or a mark (default --ds-chart-bg-color).
--ds-chart-annotation-halo-width: Thickness of that halo, as the SVG stroke-width drawn under the glyphs rather than over them (default 3px).
--ds-chart-area-color: Fill of a line series' area band, flat or fading (unset by default, so each band takes its own series colour).
--ds-chart-area-fade-opacity: Opacity an `area: 'fade'` band starts at beside its line before it fades to nothing at the baseline (default 0.32). Set this, not --chart-area-fade-opacity.
--ds-chart-area-opacity: Opacity of the band a line series fills down to its axis baseline. Set this, not --chart-area-opacity.
--ds-chart-axis-font-size: Chart axis label size. Set this, not --chart-axis-font-size.
--ds-chart-axis-label-color: Chart axis tick-label colour. Set this, not --chart-axis-label-color.
--ds-chart-axis-line-color: Chart axis line colour. Set this, not --chart-axis-line-color.
--ds-chart-bar-gap: Gap between bars in a chart series. Set this, not --chart-bar-gap.
--ds-chart-bg-color: Chart background: the frame fill and every knockout between marks - line halos, stacked-band seams, hatch stripes, label halos (default --surface-default). Set this, not --chart-bg-color.
--ds-chart-cursor-line-color: Chart crosshair line colour. Set this, not --chart-cursor-line-color.
--ds-chart-dim-opacity: Opacity every chart mark that is not singled out drops to - under dimOthers while one is hovered or focused, and under a legend item or a highlighted series or segment. One value for every chart. Set this, not --chart-dim-opacity.
--ds-chart-dot-radius: Chart data-point dot radius. Set this, not --chart-dot-radius.
--ds-chart-dot-radius-active: Chart data-point dot radius while active. Set this, not --chart-dot-radius-active.
--ds-chart-focus-halo-color: Glow drawn round a chart mark's focus ring so it stands apart from a same-hue mark (defaults to --ds-chart-bg-color).
--ds-chart-frame-bg-color: Fill of a framed chart's box (defaults to --ds-chart-bg-color).
--ds-chart-grid-line-color: Chart gridline colour. Set this, not --chart-grid-line-color.
--ds-chart-hatch-color: Stripe colour of a `fill: 'hatched'` column and of its tooltip swatch (defaults to --ds-chart-bg-color on the column, --surface-default in the tooltip).
--ds-chart-heat-1-color: Lightest of the eight heat-scale steps a ds-heatmap-chart buckets its cells into, the low end of the range. Set this, not --chart-heat-1.
--ds-chart-heat-2-color: Heat-scale step 2 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-2.
--ds-chart-heat-3-color: Heat-scale step 3 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-3.
--ds-chart-heat-4-color: Heat-scale step 4 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-4.
--ds-chart-heat-5-color: Heat-scale step 5 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-5.
--ds-chart-heat-6-color: Heat-scale step 6 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-6.
--ds-chart-heat-7-color: Heat-scale step 7 of 8, running low to high. Set this, not --chart-heat-7.
--ds-chart-heat-8-color: Darkest of the eight heat-scale steps, the high end of the range. Set this, not --chart-heat-8.
--ds-chart-hover-bg-color: Chart hover highlight wash. Set this, not --chart-hover-bg-color.
--ds-chart-legend-swatch-size: Diameter of the round colour chip in ds-chart-legend, on both axes (default --space-2-5). ds-line-chart feeds it from --ds-line-chart-swatch-size.
--ds-chart-legend-hover-bg-color: Tint behind a legend entry under the pointer or holding keyboard focus, in ds-chart-legend and the ds-pie-chart legend (default --surface-secondary).
--ds-chart-legend-hover-text-color: Label colour of a hovered or focused legend entry, in ds-chart-legend and the ds-pie-chart legend (default --text-primary).
--ds-chart-line-width: Chart line-series stroke width. Set this, not --chart-line-width.
--ds-chart-line-width-bold: Emphasised chart line-series stroke width. Set this, not --chart-line-width-bold.
--ds-chart-negative-color: Colour of a falling bar in ds-waterfall-chart, defaulting to the palette's coral --chart-negative rather than to --error for the same reason. Set this, not --chart-negative.
--ds-chart-plot-bg-color: Fill of the plot rectangle inside the axes in ds-chart and ds-scatter-chart (unset by default, so it is transparent and the chart background shows through).
--ds-chart-positive-color: Colour of a rising bar in ds-waterfall-chart. A rise is a direction and not a success, so it defaults to the palette's teal --chart-positive rather than to --success. Set this, not --chart-positive.
--ds-chart-series-1-color: Colour of the first chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-1.
--ds-chart-series-2-color: Colour of the second chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-2.
--ds-chart-series-3-color: Colour of the third chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-3.
--ds-chart-series-4-color: Colour of the fourth chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-4.
--ds-chart-series-5-color: Colour of the fifth chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-5.
--ds-chart-series-6-color: Colour of the sixth chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-6.
--ds-chart-series-7-color: Colour of the seventh chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-7.
--ds-chart-series-8-color: Colour of the eighth chart series. Set this, not --chart-categorical-8.
--ds-chart-threshold-band-opacity: Fill opacity of a reference band. Set this, not --chart-threshold-band-opacity.
--ds-chart-threshold-color: Reference line and band colour, where a threshold sets none of its own. Set this, not --chart-threshold-color.
--ds-chart-threshold-dashed-pattern: stroke-dasharray of a `dash: 'dashed'` reference line. Set this, not --chart-threshold-dashed-pattern.
--ds-chart-threshold-dotted-pattern: stroke-dasharray of a `dash: 'dotted'` reference line. Set this, not --chart-threshold-dotted-pattern.
--ds-chart-tooltip-bg-color: Chart tooltip fill. Set this, not --chart-tooltip-bg-color.
--ds-chart-tooltip-border-color: Chart tooltip border colour. Set this, not --chart-tooltip-border-color.
--ds-chart-tooltip-text-color: Chart tooltip text colour. Set this, not --chart-tooltip-text-color.
--ds-check-mark-enter-duration: How long a check mark takes to land, for the marks under this scope only. Defaults to the --ds-motion-check-enter-duration role.
--ds-check-mark-enter-easing: Easing a check mark lands on, for the marks under this scope only. Defaults to the --ds-motion-check-enter-easing role.
--ds-check-mark-exit-duration: How long a check mark takes to leave, for the marks under this scope only. Defaults to the --ds-motion-check-exit-duration role.
--ds-check-mark-exit-easing: Easing a check mark leaves on, for the marks under this scope only. Defaults to the --ds-motion-check-exit-easing role.
--ds-checkbox-gap: Space between the box and its label.
--ds-checkbox-hover-border-color: Checkbox border colour on hover (defaults to --accent).
--ds-checkbox-label-color: Checkbox caption text colour (defaults to --text-primary). A control caption is deliberately NOT part of the --ds-field-label-* contract: a label above an input is a heading for the field and reads secondary, while a caption beside a checkbox is the content you are agreeing to and reads primary. Routing them together would put "Remember me" in uppercase in any brand that sets --ds-field-label-text-transform.
--ds-checkbox-label-font-size: Checkbox caption size. Overrides the size class, so setting it pins the caption regardless of `size`.
--ds-checkbox-message-indent: Indent of the hint under a checkbox; set it to the box plus the gap to align with the label.
--ds-checkbox-radius: Checkbox box corner radius (defaults to --ds-radius-inner). The indeterminate dash keeps its own radius.
--ds-checkbox-row-align: Cross-alignment of the box and its label.
--ds-color-picker-hue-height: Colour picker hue slider height (defaults to --color-picker-hue-h).
--ds-color-picker-saturation-value-heigh: Colour picker saturation/value area height (defaults to --color-picker-sv-h).
--ds-color-picker-thumb: Colour picker slider thumb size (defaults to --color-picker-thumb).
--ds-color-picker-trigger-border-color: Colour picker trigger button border colour.
--ds-column-chart-axis-width: Minimum width of the ds-column-chart value-axis gutter, which widens to fit the widest tick label (default 40px). Read back as a number, so it takes a px length only.
--ds-column-chart-cap-radius: Corner radius of a column's rounded cap, held to half the column's height (defaults to --ds-chart-mark-cap-radius, 3px).
--ds-column-chart-column-gap: Space between the columns of grouped series in one category (defaults to --ds-chart-bar-gap).
--ds-column-chart-column-max-width: Widest a column grows, however wide its category slot (default 48px).
--ds-column-chart-column-width: Share of its category slot a column fills, as a percentage (default 80%). Read back as a number.
--ds-column-chart-grid-line-color: Gridline colour of a ds-column-chart, which re-points --ds-chart-grid-line-color on its plot (defaults to --ds-chart-grid-line-color).
--ds-column-chart-plot-height: Height of the ds-column-chart plot, axis labels and headroom excluded (default 200px). Read back as a number, so it takes a px length only.
--ds-column-chart-value-space: Room reserved above the plot, and below it once a value goes negative, for the column value labels (default --space-5, 20px). Read back as a number, so it takes a px length only.
--ds-container-padding-x: Horizontal page padding, fluid: clamp(--space-4, 4vw, --space-6). The vertical counterpart is --ds-surface-padding.
--ds-control-focus-shadow: Shared focus ring shadow reused across interactive controls.
--ds-control-focus-shadow-error: Focus ring shadow for controls in error state (defaults to --focus-field-error).
--ds-date-picker-day-muted-label-color: Muted calendar day text colour (outside-month days).
--ds-date-picker-focus-shadow: Date picker focus ring shadow (defaults to --ds-control-focus-shadow).
--ds-date-picker-max-width: Cap on the field width (default 100%); with fullWidth the field fills its container up to this width.
--ds-date-picker-panel-radius: Calendar panel corner radius (default --radius-lg). Forwarded onto the portaled pane on open.
--ds-date-picker-placeholder-color: Date picker trigger placeholder text colour.
--ds-date-picker-required-color: Date picker required-field asterisk colour (defaults to --error).
--ds-date-picker-trigger-bg-color: Date picker trigger field surface fill.
--ds-date-picker-trigger-border-color: Date picker trigger field border colour.
--ds-date-picker-trigger-label-color: Date picker trigger field value text colour.
--ds-date-picker-trigger-padding-x: Trigger horizontal padding; follows the field family via --field-pad-x, so it tracks density like ds-input.
--ds-date-picker-trigger-radius: Date-picker trigger corner radius (default --radius-md) — the counterpart of --ds-time-picker-trigger-radius.
--ds-date-picker-value-font-family: Font family of the date value AND its ghost mask (default --font-mono — fixed-width digits keep the typed value on the mask; a proportional override still lines up thanks to tabular-nums).
--ds-date-picker-value-font-size: Size of the date value and its ghost mask (default --font-size-s).
--ds-date-picker-value-font-weight: Weight of the date value and its ghost mask (default --font-weight-regular).
--ds-description-item-term-font-size: Description list term font size (defaults to --font-size-s).
--ds-description-item-term-font-weight: Term (label) weight. Completes the eyebrow set the modal eyebrow and ds-field-label already expose.
--ds-description-item-term-text-transfor: Term text-transform (default none) — set uppercase for an eyebrow-style label column.
--ds-description-list-column-gap: Description list term/details column gap (defaults to --space-5).
--ds-description-list-label-width: Description list term column width (defaults to --dl-spec-label-w).
--ds-description-list-value-min-width: Narrowest value beside the label before every item of the list stacks (defaults to --dl-spec-value-min-w).
--ds-drawer-close-icon-color-hover: Drawer close icon colour on hover (defaults to --icon-strong).
--ds-drawer-enter-duration: Drawer entrance duration (default --duration-slow); the scrim uses --duration-fast until this is set.
--ds-drawer-enter-keyframes: Drawer panel entrance @keyframes, shared by all four sides (default ds-slide-edge-in).
--ds-drawer-enter-scale: Start scale if the drawer enters with ds-scale-in (default 0.96).
--ds-drawer-leave-duration: Drawer close duration (default --duration-base); the scrim uses --duration-fast until this is set.
--ds-drawer-leave-keyframes: Exit keyframes name (default ds-slide-edge-out, which travels back the way the panel arrived). One token covers all four sides.
--ds-drawer-title-color: Drawer title text colour (defaults to inherited colour).
--ds-drawer-width: Panel width for every `size` of a left/right drawer; unset, each size reads --drawer-w-sm|md|lg.
--ds-dropdown-panel-max-height: Connected dropdown panel height before it scrolls (default 320px). The option list inside stops sooner, at --picker-maxh.
--ds-dropdown-panel-max-width: Upper bound for the same panel, and the reason `width="content"` is safe over a trigger whose options are long: without it the panel grows to its widest option. Same `content`-only caveat as --ds-dropdown-panel-min-width.
--ds-dropdown-panel-min-width: Lower bound for the connected dropdown panel behind ds-select and ds-multi-select. Only bites in `width="content"`, where the pane is auto-sized and the trigger is merely its floor; in `fill` the component pins the pane to the trigger and there is nothing left to bound. Forwarded onto the portaled pane, so a host-scoped value reaches it.
--ds-dropdown-panel-radius: Corner of the connected dropdown panel behind ds-select, ds-multi-select and ds-autocomplete (defaults to the --ds-radius-panel role). The middle lever between retuning one picker, which the library does not encourage, and moving every panel — modal, popover, date picker — with the role. Scope it with a selector (`ds-select { … }`); it is forwarded onto the portaled pane, so a host-scoped value reaches it.
--ds-dropzone-file-border: Dropzone file row border colour (defaults to --border-default).
--ds-dropzone-file-name-color: Dropzone file name text colour (defaults to --text-primary).
--ds-dropzone-max-width: Panel width cap; unset lets it fill its column.
--ds-elevation-floating: Elevation role for a surface above overlays — toasts. Defaults to --shadow-3.
--ds-elevation-modal: Elevation role for a surface that owns the screen — modals, drawers, sheets, the overlay rail. Defaults to --shadow-4.
--ds-elevation-overlay: Elevation role for a panel anchored to a trigger — popovers, menus, dropdowns, tooltips. Defaults to --shadow-2.
--ds-elevation-raised: Elevation role for a resting surface that lifts off the page — cards, stats, the segmented thumb. Defaults to --shadow-1.
--ds-empty-state-title-font-family: Empty state title face (default --font-sans; ds-modal's title uses --font-heading, so a display face on both is two declarations).
--ds-empty-state-title-font-size: Empty state title font size (defaults to --font-size-h5).
--ds-field-border-color: Resting border colour for the text-entry fields - input, textarea, select, multi-select, autocomplete and search - read under each one's own border token, so --ds-input-border or --ds-select-border-color still wins where set. Default --border-default. The date, time and colour pickers keep their own -trigger-* tokens.
--ds-field-border-color-focus: Focused (and open, for the pickers) border colour for the same six fields, under each one's own token. Default --accent.
--ds-field-border-color-hover: Hovered border colour for the same six fields, under each one's own token. Default --border-strong; ds-search keeps its border steady on hover unless --ds-search-border-hover is set.
--ds-field-focus-shadow: Field focus ring shadow — themeable (defaults to --focus-field).
--ds-field-focus-shadow-error: Field focus ring shadow in error state (defaults to --focus-field-error).
--ds-field-focus-shadow-warning: Field focus shadow in warning state (defaults to --focus-field-warning).
--ds-field-focus-shadow-success: Field focus shadow in success state (defaults to --focus-field-success).
--ds-field-font-size: Text size of the same six fields, under each one's own token (--ds-input-font-size, --ds-select-font-size, ...). Default --font-size-s.
--ds-field-group-bg-color: Fill behind the whole glued row.
--ds-field-group-border-color: The single border the group draws around all its segments.
--ds-field-group-border-color-error: Border colour of a ds-field-group marked invalid. Defaults to --error; the group draws the row's one border, so its segments never paint their own.
--ds-field-group-border-color-focus: Border colour while any segment has focus (default --accent).
--ds-field-group-focus-shadow: The ONE focus ring for the group (default --ds-field-focus-shadow) — segments suppress their own.
--ds-field-group-focus-shadow-error: The halo a ds-field-group draws while invalid AND focused. Defaults to --ds-field-focus-shadow-error, the halo a single error field uses.
--ds-field-group-radius: Corner radius of the group (default --ds-radius-control); the end segments are clipped to it.
--ds-field-height: Control-box height for the field family, overriding the size class. The sm/md/lg defaults come from the --field-h-* scale; set this to pin one height regardless of size.
--ds-field-label-color: Label colour for the field family — input, textarea, select, both pickers and radio-group. Does NOT reach the checkbox / switch / radio CAPTIONS, which have their own --ds-<control>-label-color: see those for why.
--ds-field-label-font-size: Label size for the whole field family — input, textarea, select, both pickers and radio-group resolve through it.
--ds-field-label-font-weight: Label weight for the whole field family.
--ds-field-label-letter-spacing: Label letter-spacing, for uppercase labels that need opening up. Default `normal`.
--ds-field-label-text-transform: Label text-transform — set `uppercase` for the tracked editorial label pattern. Default `none`.
--ds-field-message-icon-gap: Space between the state glyph and the message text (default --space-1). Also the row gap when there is no glyph, since the row holds nothing else.
--ds-field-message-icon-offset: Top offset that centres the 14px glyph on the FIRST line of the message rather than on the whole block, which matters once a message wraps. Defaults to a calc over --ds-field-message-font-size and --line-height-base, so it still holds if the message type is retuned; set a length to override.
--ds-field-placeholder-color: Placeholder colour of the same six fields, under each one's own token. Default --text-tertiary.
--ds-field-text-color: Value text colour of the same six fields, under each one's own token. Default --text-primary.
--ds-filter-bar-gap: Space between filters, and between the row and the trailing group (defaults to --space-3). Read back off the DOM by the overflow arithmetic, so retuning it stays in sync with what is rendered.
--ds-filter-bar-panel-gap: Vertical space between filters stacked in the overflow panel (defaults to --space-4, looser than the row because they read as a form there).
--ds-heatmap-chart-cell-gap: Space between neighbouring cells, applied as the grid table's border-spacing (default 2px).
--ds-heatmap-chart-cell-radius: Corner radius of a cell (defaults to the --ds-radius-control role).
--ds-heatmap-chart-cell-size: Side of one grid cell, on both axes, and the height of a row in the loading skeleton (default 34px).
--ds-heatmap-chart-focus-color: Focus-ring colour of an interactive cell (default --focus-ring-color).
--ds-heatmap-chart-focus-width: Focus-ring thickness of an interactive cell (default --focus-ring-width).
--ds-heatmap-chart-label-color: Colour of the row and column labels around the grid (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-label-color).
--ds-heatmap-chart-label-font-size: Type size of those row and column labels (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-font-size).
--ds-heatmap-chart-missing-color: Fill of a cell whose value is null, which no step of the heat scale stands for (default --surface-secondary).
--ds-icon-button-bg-color: Surface fill — variants re-point the default (filled/selected → --primary).
--ds-icon-button-bg-color-active: Pressed fill — follows hover unless set; filled/selected derive 76% mix.
--ds-icon-button-bg-color-disabled: Disabled fill — boxless for standard, a pale accent tint for filled, color-mix(fill 28%, surface-disabled) for tonal, transparent for outlined.
--ds-icon-button-bg-color-hover: Hover fill — filled/selected derive it from the resolved bg.
--ds-icon-button-border-active: Border colour while pressed. Defaults to --ds-icon-button-border-hover.
--ds-icon-button-border-hover: Border colour on hover. Defaults to the resting --ds-icon-button-border (the outlined variant's own border included), so nothing moves until this is set.
--ds-icon-button-icon-color-disabled: Disabled icon — same single recipe as ds-button's label, oklch(from accent 70% 0.035 h). It matters more here: there is no word to read, only a 16px glyph.
--ds-icon-button-size: Icon button hit area size (defaults to --hit-cozy).
--ds-icon-size: Icon glyph box for every icon under this scope. Defaults to --icon-md; a per-instance `size` input beats it.
--ds-info-hint-color: Info hint icon colour, at rest and on hover (defaults to --icon-default).
--ds-inline-gap: Default gap for inline-arranged layouts (defaults to --space-inline).
--ds-input-focus-shadow-error: Input focus ring shadow when invalid (defaults to --ds-field-focus-shadow-error).
--ds-input-font-size: Value text size. Also read by ds-textarea.
--ds-line-chart-annotation-font-weight: Weight of a ds-line-chart annotation label (default --font-weight-bold). The chart republishes it as --ds-chart-annotation-font-weight, so this is the per-chart lever over the shared one.
--ds-link-color: Link text colour. Defaults to --blue-700 in light and a light blue from the --blue-h hue in dark.
--ds-link-color-active: Link colour while pressed. Defaults to the link colour mixed 65% with black.
--ds-link-color-hover: Link colour on hover. Defaults to the link colour mixed 80% with black.
--ds-list-divider-color: Divider colour between list items (defaults to --border-divider).
--ds-list-item-gap: Gap between list item content parts (defaults to --list-item-gap).
--ds-list-item-label-color: List item label text colour (defaults to --text-primary).
--ds-list-item-selected-icon-color: Icon colour in a selected list row. Defaults to the row's selected label colour, so icon and text move together.
--ds-list-item-selected-label-color: List item label colour when selected (defaults to --accent-strong).
--ds-list-item-subtitle-color: List item subtitle text colour (defaults to --text-tertiary).
--ds-loading-overlay-enter-scale: Start scale if the scrim enters with ds-scale-in (default 0.96).
--ds-loading-overlay-label-color: Loading overlay status text colour (defaults to --text-secondary).
--ds-loading-overlay-radius: Corner radius of the loading scrim (default 0); match the covered container's radius.
--ds-loading-overlay-scrim-color: Loading overlay scrim tint over the canvas (opacity-driven mix of --surface-canvas).
--ds-menu-clip-radius: Radius a ds-menu clips its rows to when it sits inside a rounded panel. Published by ds-popover as its own radius less the border it contains, so the rows stay concentric with the panel; a bare menu leaves it flat and rounds its edge rows from --ds-menu-radius instead.
--ds-menu-divider-color: Menu item group divider colour (defaults to --border-divider).
--ds-menu-divider-spacing: Air above and below a ds-menu-divider. Default 0 means FLUSH: the divider cancels the menu's row gap, so items touch the line. Set it only to make the boundary breathe more than the rows — it is the one knob that can desync the divider from the row rhythm. For an airier menu, --ds-menu-gap spaces every row evenly.
--ds-menu-item-description-color: Colour of a ds-menu-item `description` — the standing second line under the label (default --text-tertiary, quieter than the label so the action still reads first).
--ds-menu-item-description-font-size: Type size of that second line (default --font-size-2xs).
--ds-menu-item-description-max-width: Where the description wraps (default 14rem). It exists because the line is prose, and an unbounded one would stretch the menu to the width of its longest sentence.
--ds-menu-item-error-label-color: Destructive menu item label colour (defaults to --error-text).
--ds-menu-item-icon-size: Menu-item icon box. Defaults to 16px, and it is the width every item reserves once any item in the menu has an icon, so the labels line up.
--ds-menu-item-quiet-label-color: Label colour for a [quiet] item (default --text-secondary) — a secondary row like "Sign out" under a divider.
--ds-menu-item-radius: Corner radius of a menu row (default 0). Square by design: rows sit flush inside the panel, whose own radius is --ds-menu-radius.
--ds-menu-max-width: Maximum menu width (default none). Pairs with --ds-menu-min-width; forwarded onto the pane by ds-popover.
--ds-menu-min-width: Minimum menu width (default auto). Forwarded onto the overlay pane by ds-popover, so it also works for a menu projected into a popover.
--ds-menu-radius: Corner of a bare ds-menu (default --radius-md, which is what the component hardcoded before). Inside a ds-popover the menu clips to --ds-menu-clip-radius instead, published by the popover.
--ds-modal-actions-padding-bottom: Padding on the modal's actions, bottom edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-actions-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-actions-padding-top: Padding on the modal's actions, top edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-actions-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-actions-padding-y: Vertical padding of the footer actions row. Worth tightening alongside --ds-modal-divider: transparent, which leaves spacing sized for dividers that are gone.
--ds-modal-actions-stacked-direction: flex-direction of the actions row once it stacks (default column, confirming action at the bottom, DOM order = Tab order). Set to column-reverse to put the confirming action on top.
--ds-modal-body-padding-bottom: Padding on the modal's body, bottom edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-body-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-body-padding-top: Padding on the modal's body, top edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-body-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-body-padding-y: Vertical padding of the body. Falls to 0 under [dividers]="false", since it exists to clear a rule; set this token to keep a value in both modes.
--ds-modal-divider: Header/actions divider colour. To remove the rules entirely use [dividers]="false" — it also drops the padding they were sized for, which setting this to transparent does not.
--ds-modal-enter-keyframes: Modal card entrance @keyframes (default ds-fade-in); the backdrop always fades.
--ds-modal-enter-scale: Start scale for the modal card once --ds-modal-enter-keyframes is ds-scale-in (default 0.97).
--ds-modal-eyebrow-font-size: Size of the [eyebrow] line above the dialog title (default --font-size-xs).
--ds-modal-eyebrow-font-weight: Weight of the [eyebrow] line above the dialog title (default --font-weight-bold).
--ds-modal-eyebrow-letter-spacing: Letter-spacing of the [eyebrow] line (default --letter-spacing-wide) — it renders uppercase by default.
--ds-modal-eyebrow-text-color: Colour of the optional [eyebrow] line above the dialog title (default --text-tertiary).
--ds-modal-eyebrow-text-transform: text-transform for the [eyebrow] line (default uppercase; set none for sentence case).
--ds-modal-header-padding-bottom: Padding on the modal's header, bottom edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-header-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-header-padding-top: Padding on the modal's header, top edge only. Falls back to --ds-modal-header-padding-y, which sets both.
--ds-modal-header-padding-y: Vertical padding of the header row.
--ds-modal-icon-badge-bg-color: Modal header icon badge fill (defaults to --accent-subtitle).
--ds-modal-icon-badge-icon-color: Modal header icon badge glyph colour (defaults to --accent).
--ds-modal-impact-text-color: Modal impact/warning message text colour (defaults to --warning-text).
--ds-modal-leave-duration: Modal close duration (default --duration-fast). Reduced motion zeroes it so teardown stays instant.
--ds-modal-leave-keyframes: Exit keyframes name (default ds-fade-out). Must name GLOBAL @keyframes — a component-scoped name is renamed by Angular and will not resolve.
--ds-modal-padding-x: Horizontal gutter shared by the header, body and actions. Set it on ds-modal AND ds-modal-card — a dialog opened through ModalService has no ds-modal ancestor.
--ds-modal-subtitle-font-size: Size of the optional subtitle under the title (default --font-size-s).
--ds-modal-subtitle-text-color: Colour of the optional subtitle under the title (default --text-secondary).
--ds-motion-chart-mark-detail-duration: How long what follows a mark takes to arrive: its value label, a marker. Defaults to --duration-base (180ms).
--ds-motion-chart-mark-enter-duration: How long a chart mark takes to fade or settle in. Defaults to --duration-slower (400ms).
--ds-motion-chart-mark-enter-easing: Easing a chart mark arrives on. Defaults to --ease-emphasized-decelerate.
--ds-motion-chart-mark-grow-duration: How long a column, bar or waterfall step takes to grow out of its baseline. Defaults to --duration-slowest (600ms).
--ds-motion-chart-mark-grow-easing: Easing a mark grows on. Defaults to --ease-settle.
--ds-motion-chart-mark-sweep-duration: How long a pie ring takes to turn in or a line to draw on. Defaults to --duration-slowest (600ms).
--ds-motion-check-enter-duration: How long a check mark takes to land. Defaults to --duration-base.
--ds-motion-check-enter-easing: Easing a check mark lands on. Defaults to --ease-spring, which overshoots and settles.
--ds-motion-check-exit-duration: How long a check mark takes to leave. Defaults to --duration-fast, shorter than the entrance.
--ds-motion-check-exit-easing: Easing a check mark leaves on. Defaults to --ease-accelerate, so it does not overshoot on the way out.
--ds-motion-enter-large-duration: Entrance duration for a large surface travelling a long distance — drawer, toast. Defaults to --duration-slow.
--ds-motion-enter-large-easing: Entrance easing for a large surface. Defaults to --ease-decelerate.
--ds-motion-enter-panel-duration: Entrance duration for a small anchored panel. Defaults to --duration-fast.
--ds-motion-enter-panel-easing: Entrance easing for a small anchored panel. Defaults to --ease-decelerate.
--ds-motion-enter-surface-duration: Entrance duration for a mid-sized surface — modal, alert, banner, bottom sheet. Defaults to --duration-base.
--ds-motion-enter-surface-easing: Entrance easing for a mid-sized surface. Defaults to --ease-decelerate.
--ds-motion-exit-duration: Exit duration for a panel or scrim. Defaults to --duration-fast.
--ds-motion-exit-large-duration: Exit duration for a large surface — drawer, bottom sheet. Defaults to --duration-base, because a panel that travels far reads as clipped when it leaves at the short duration.
--ds-motion-exit-large-easing: Exit easing for a large surface. Defaults to --ease-accelerate.
--ds-multi-select-border-color-focus: Multi-select trigger border while the field holds focus (defaults to --accent).
--ds-multi-select-border-color-hover: Trigger border colour on hover (default --ds-field-border-color-hover, then --border-strong).
--ds-multi-select-option-bg-color-active: Option row fill under the keyboard cursor and the pointer, for this multi-select's panel only (default --surface-secondary).
--ds-multi-select-panel-bg-color: Dropdown panel surface (default --surface-overlay). The panel is portaled, so set it on the host — a global rule against the pane cannot see the host override.
--ds-multi-select-placeholder-color: Placeholder colour shown while nothing is selected (default --ds-field-placeholder-color, then --text-tertiary).
--ds-number-stepper-step-bg-color-active: Number stepper increment/decrement button fill when pressed (defaults to --accent-muted).
--ds-option-bg-color-active: Option row fill under the keyboard cursor and the pointer (default --surface-secondary).
--ds-option-check-color: The check glyph on a selected row (default --primary).
--ds-option-color: Label colour of an unselected option.
--ds-option-font-weight: Weight of an option row's label in a dropdown panel (default --font-weight-medium).
--ds-option-gap: Gap between an option row's check, icon and label (default --space-2).
--ds-option-row-gap: Gap between option rows, not inside one (default 2px).
--ds-option-selected-bg-color: Fill of the selected row in a dropdown panel (default --primary-subtitle). Panel-level: one partial paints select, autocomplete and multi-select alike.
--ds-option-selected-bg-color-hover: Fill of the selected row while hovered or keyboard-active (default --primary-muted).
--ds-option-selected-label-color: Label and icon colour of the selected row (default --primary-strong).
--ds-otp-cell-border-color-focus: OTP input cell border on focus (defaults to --accent).
--ds-overlay-enter-keyframes: Entrance @keyframes for every portaled panel — default ds-fade-in, which fades the panel in where it stands; also ds-slide-in / ds-scale-in, your own GLOBAL keyframes, or none.
--ds-overlay-enter-offset: How far a panel travels in from the trigger edge — read by ds-slide-in (default 4px).
--ds-overlay-enter-scale: Start scale when a panel enters with ds-scale-in (default 0.96); read only after --ds-overlay-enter-keyframes is set to ds-scale-in.
--ds-overlay-leave-duration: Fade-out length when an overlay panel is DISMISSED (Escape, a press outside, a scroll). Defaults to --ds-motion-exit-duration (120ms). Choosing an option closes instantly and is not affected.
--ds-overlay-leave-easing: Easing of that dismissal fade. Defaults to --ds-motion-exit-easing.
--ds-page-header-crumb-text-color: Breadcrumb link colour in the page header; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-label-color.
--ds-page-header-crumb-text-color-hover: Breadcrumb link hover colour in the page header; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-label-color-hover.
--ds-page-header-subtitle-font-size: Subtitle size (default --font-size-s). The title has --ds-page-header-title-font-size beside it.
--ds-page-header-title-font-size: Title size — 28px, dropping to 22px below the mobile breakpoint. Raise it for a brand-scale header; 28px is the productive-UI rung.
--ds-pagination-label-font-size: Size of the "Showing X–Y of Z" range label (default --font-size-s).
--ds-password-rules-failed-color: Colour of a rule the current value breaks (default --error-text). Only once [showUnmet] is true - see the pending colour.
--ds-password-rules-font-size: Rule line size (default --font-size-xs) — a checklist beside a field, not body copy.
--ds-password-rules-gap: Space between rule lines in ds-password-rules (default --space-1).
--ds-password-rules-pending-color: Colour of an unmet rule before [showUnmet] turns on (default --text-tertiary) - must not read as failure.
--ds-pie-chart-focus-color: Focus-ring colour for a slice (default --focus-ring-color). The ring is stroked onto the arc by the shared chart mixin, which reads --ds-chart-focus-ring-color, so nothing resolves this one.
--ds-pie-chart-focus-width: Focus-ring thickness for a slice (default --focus-ring-width), with the same caveat: the stroked ring reads --focus-ring-width itself, so nothing resolves this one.
--ds-pie-chart-gap: Space between the ring and its legend, whichever side the legend sits on (default --space-5).
--ds-pie-chart-legend-row-gap: Vertical gap between legend rows, and the wrap gap when the legend sits below the ring (default --space-2).
--ds-pie-chart-legend-row-height: Height of one legend row in the loading skeleton only (default 16px); a real row is sized by its own text.
--ds-pie-chart-outline-width: Border thickness of the placeholder ring drawn while the chart is empty or errored, and over the real ring when every slice is zero (defaults to --border-width-strong plus --border-width-default); the hole's inner border scales from it by the hole fraction.
--ds-pie-chart-center-value-min-font-siz: Smallest size the centre value shrinks to in a narrow hole (default --font-size-s, 14px). Past it the sum prints in its compact form, unless centerCompact is off.
--ds-pie-chart-size: Outer diameter of the ring, on both axes (default 180px). The hole is a fraction of it, set by [hole] on the component rather than by a token.
--ds-pie-chart-swatch-size: Side of the round colour chip in a legend row, on both axes (default 10px).
--ds-popover-min-width: Minimum panel width (default auto — the panel hugs its content). Set it to widen a menu/actions popover without touching internals.
--ds-popover-radius: Popover corner radius (defaults to the --ds-radius-panel role).
--ds-press-brightness: How far a pressed control darkens. Defaults to 0.9, applied as a brightness filter.
--ds-press-scale: How far a pressed control shrinks. Defaults to 0.97.
--ds-radio-label-color: Radio caption text colour (defaults to --text-primary). A control caption is deliberately NOT part of the --ds-field-label-* contract: a label above an input is a heading for the field and reads secondary, while a caption beside a checkbox is the content you are agreeing to and reads primary. Routing them together would put "Remember me" in uppercase in any brand that sets --ds-field-label-text-transform.
--ds-radio-label-font-size: Radio caption size. Overrides the size class, so setting it pins the caption regardless of `size`.
--ds-radius-control: Radius role for controls and field frames — buttons, inputs, selects, both picker triggers, tooltips. Defaults to --radius-md.
--ds-radius-inner: Radius role for shapes INSIDE a control — the checkbox box, an option row, a tag. Defaults to --radius-sm.
--ds-radius-panel: Radius role for floating and container surfaces — menus, popovers, cards, modals, drawers, sheets. Defaults to --radius-lg.
--ds-radius-pill: Radius role for fully round shapes — avatars, badges, switch tracks. Defaults to --radius-pill.
--ds-scatter-chart-axis-font-size: Type size of those tick labels (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-font-size).
--ds-scatter-chart-axis-label-color: Fill of the axis tick labels (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-label-color).
--ds-scatter-chart-axis-line-color: Stroke of the two axis lines (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-line-color).
--ds-scatter-chart-dot-opacity: fill-opacity of a plotted point, held under 1 so overlapping points read as a denser cluster (default 0.72).
--ds-scatter-chart-dot-radius: Radius of a plotted point, as the SVG r attribute (defaults to --ds-chart-dot-radius).
--ds-scatter-chart-focus-color: Focus-ring colour for a point (default --focus-ring-color). The ring is stroked onto the dot by the shared chart mixin, which reads --ds-chart-focus-ring-color, so nothing resolves this one.
--ds-scatter-chart-focus-width: Focus-ring thickness for a point (default --focus-ring-width), with the same caveat: the stroked ring reads --focus-ring-width itself, so nothing resolves this one.
--ds-scatter-chart-grid-line-color: Stroke of the plot's gridlines (defaults to --ds-chart-grid-line-color).
--ds-scrollbar-width: Native scrollbar width measured per device and published on :root; app-layout subtracts it from the content's right padding to keep insets symmetric.
--ds-search-max-width: Search field max-width cap (none by default).
--ds-segmented-padding: Segmented control track inner padding (defaults to --segmented-pad).
--ds-segmented-radius: Outer radius of the segmented track. Defaults to the inner radius plus the track padding, so the selected chip and the track stay concentric — set both if you override this.
--ds-segmented-radius-inner: Segmented control button corner radius (defaults to --segmented-r-inner).
--ds-segmented-segment-border: Segment border (default 0) — set a hairline for a bordered chip row.
--ds-segmented-selected-bg-color: Fill of the selected segment, which reads as a raised chip on the track (defaults to --surface-default).
--ds-segmented-selected-label-color: Label colour of the selected segment (defaults to --text-primary).
--ds-select-border-color-focus: Trigger border colour while focused or open (default --ds-field-border-color-focus, then --accent).
--ds-select-border-color-hover: Trigger border colour on hover (default --ds-field-border-color-hover, then --border-strong).
--ds-select-focus-shadow-error: Select focus ring — invalid state (defaults to --ds-field-focus-shadow-error).
--ds-select-placeholder-color: Placeholder colour while no value is selected (default --ds-field-placeholder-color, then --text-tertiary).
--ds-sidenav-brand-max-height: Height cap for a logo projected into the [brand] slot; `none` by default, so an oversized logo sets the brand row's height until you set this. Height only — an image with no CSS width keeps its ratio on its own.
--ds-sidenav-footer-dot-size: Unread indicator dot diameter (6px); pins to the icon corner when the rail is collapsed.
--ds-sidenav-footer-head-letter-spacing: Letter-spacing on the uppercase group heading in the search/alerts popovers (0.04em).
--ds-sidenav-footer-popover-max-height: Search/alerts popover max height before the panel scrolls (56vh).
--ds-sidenav-footer-popover-max-width: Search/alerts popover max width clamp for narrow viewports (82vw).
--ds-sidenav-item-rail: Edge marker on the active item (defaults to --accent-strong, the same colour as the active label). It is the second signal beside the wash, so the state does not rest on colour alone — turn it off with [rail] on ds-sidenav or ds-sidenav-item rather than painting it transparent.
--ds-skeleton-wave-angle: 135deg — the direction the waves travel, down and to the right. The gradient repeats along this axis, which is what leaves no seam to meet.
--ds-skeleton-wave-duration: 3400ms — one period of travel, in which two waves cross: a quiet one and a main one. Slower than the shared loop token on purpose: a placeholder is background and should not pull the eye.
--ds-skeleton-wave-echo-color: The quieter wave, sitting exactly between two main ones. Defaults to the shimmer tone at 30%, meant to be noticed only as the page not standing still.
--ds-skeleton-wave-period: 56rem — the distance from one wave to the next of the same kind, measured along the direction they travel. The quiet wave sits at half of it, so crossings alternate at exactly even intervals.
--ds-skeleton-wave-steps: Updates per wave pass (default 68); each step is main-thread work.
--ds-slider-track-color: Slider track fill behind the thumb (defaults to --surface-muted).
--ds-sparkline-area-color: Fill of the area under a ds-sparkline line (defaults to the line colour, --ds-sparkline-line-color).
--ds-sparkline-area-opacity: Opacity of that area fill (defaults to --ds-chart-area-opacity).
--ds-sparkline-dot-radius: Radius of the dot on the last reading of a ds-sparkline (default 2.5px).
--ds-sparkline-line-color: Stroke colour of a ds-sparkline line (defaults to --ds-chart-series-1-color).
--ds-sparkline-line-width: Stroke width of a ds-sparkline line (default 1.5px).
--ds-split-button-bg-color-active: Split-button fill while pressed. Defaults to its own fill mixed 76% with black.
--ds-split-button-bg-color-hover: Split button hover fill (defaults to --accent-hover). Not --accent-strong: that is the on-tint colour for text on a light surface, and as a fill it leaves the label unreadable.
--ds-split-button-divider-color: Split button divider between main and caret segments.
--ds-split-button-outline-bg-color: Fill of the outlined split button. Transparent by default, so it adopts the surface it sits on.
--ds-split-button-outline-bg-color-activ: Pressed fill for the outline variant, which has no fill of its own to darken. Defaults to --surface-muted.
--ds-split-button-press-scale: How far the button shrinks under the pointer. Defaults to 0.98, matching ds-button.
--ds-split-button-pressed-shadow: Shadow while pressed. Defaults to `none` — the scale carries the press on its own.
--ds-stack-gap: Default gap for vertically stacked layouts (defaults to --space-stack).
--ds-stat-value-font-size: Value size. Applies at every `size`, not just the default — the sm/lg variants move this token rather than restating font-size, so one override reaches all three.
--ds-stat-value-white-space: Wrapping of the value line (default `nowrap`). Set `normal` when the value is a phrase — a date range or a status — rather than the number the tile was built around. Without it the line does not wrap and, since `.stat` sets no `overflow`, the text runs OUT of the tile rather than being clipped inside it.
--ds-status-dot-color: Dot colour; default `--icon-muted`. Set per status by `status.define`.
--ds-stepper-connector-color: Stepper connector line between nodes, pending state.
--ds-stepper-connector-done-color: Stepper connector line colour, completed segment (defaults to --accent).
--ds-stepper-label-color: Stepper step label colour, inactive state (defaults to --text-tertiary).
--ds-stepper-label-color-current: Stepper step label colour, current step (defaults to --text-primary).
--ds-stepper-node-active-bg-color: Stepper node fill, active step (defaults to --accent).
--ds-stepper-node-active-text-color: Stepper node index colour, active step (defaults to --accent-on).
--ds-stepper-node-bg-color: Stepper node fill, upcoming step (defaults to --surface-default).
--ds-stepper-node-done-text-color: Stepper node icon/index colour, completed step (defaults to --accent).
--ds-surface-padding: Default inner padding for card / stat, 24px. Retune it once here instead of per component; ultra-compact density drops it to 16px.
--ds-switch-label-color: Switch caption text colour (defaults to --text-primary). A control caption is deliberately NOT part of the --ds-field-label-* contract: a label above an input is a heading for the field and reads secondary, while a caption beside a checkbox is the content you are agreeing to and reads primary. Routing them together would put "Remember me" in uppercase in any brand that sets --ds-field-label-text-transform.
--ds-switch-label-font-size: Switch caption size. Overrides the size class, so setting it pins the caption regardless of `size`.
--ds-switch-track-off-bg-color: Switch track fill, off state (defaults to --border-strong).
--ds-switch-track-on-bg-color: Switch track fill, on state (defaults to --accent).
--ds-typography-caption-font-size: `.t-caption` font size — small print under a field or a figure.
--ds-typography-card-title-font-size: `.t-card-title` font size — the heading inside a card.
--ds-typography-display-font-size: `.t-display` font size — the largest heading, above h1.
--ds-typography-l-bold-font-size: `.t-l-bold` font size — body text, large and bold.
--ds-typography-m-font-size: `.t-m` font size — body text, the default size.
--ds-typography-mono-block-font-size: `.t-mono-block` font size — a monospaced block, its own box.
--ds-typography-mono-inline-font-size: `.t-mono-inline` font size — a monospaced run inside a sentence.
--ds-typography-mono-ligatures: Ligatures in mono type. Defaults to `none`, so `===` and `!=` show their characters rather than JetBrains Mono's combined glyph; set `normal` to get them back.
--ds-typography-overline-font-size: `.t-overline` font size — the small uppercase label above a heading.
--ds-typography-s-bold-font-size: `.t-s-bold` font size — body text, small and bold.
--ds-typography-xs-bold-font-size: `.t-xs-bold` font size — body text, extra small and bold.
--ds-typography-xs-font-size: `.t-xs` font size — body text, extra small.
--ds-tab-badge-label-color: Tab count badge text colour (defaults to --text-secondary).
--ds-tab-close-bg-color-hover: Tab close button hover fill (defaults to --surface-secondary).
--ds-tab-padding-bottom: Per-side tab padding override; falls back to --ds-tab-padding-y. An underline tab usually wants its padding here only.
--ds-tab-padding-top: Per-side tab padding override; falls back to --ds-tab-padding-y.
--ds-table-cell-link-color: Colour a cell marked `interactive: true` takes while its row is hovered on a `rowInteractive` table (default --accent). It names WHICH text opens the record, where the row tint only says the row is clickable.
--ds-table-cell-link-decoration: Decoration on that same cell (default `underline`), so the target is not signalled by hue alone. Set `none` only if something else in the row carries the signal.
--ds-table-cell-padding-bottom: Per-side cell padding override; falls back to --ds-table-cell-padding-y.
--ds-table-cell-padding-left: Per-side cell padding override (also the header gutter) — set 0 for a flush first column; falls back to --ds-table-cell-padding-x.
--ds-table-cell-padding-right: Per-side cell padding override (also the header gutter); falls back to --ds-table-cell-padding-x.
--ds-table-cell-padding-top: Per-side cell padding override; falls back to --ds-table-cell-padding-y.
--ds-table-footer-padding-bottom: Bottom padding of the pagination footer (default --ds-table-footer-padding-y).
--ds-table-footer-padding-top: Top padding of the pagination footer (default --ds-table-footer-padding-y).
--ds-table-footer-padding-y: Block padding of the pagination footer under the rows (default --space-3). The inline sides follow the cell padding chain; -top and -bottom override one side each.
--ds-table-head-border-color: Colour of the rule under the header row (default --ds-table-divider).
--ds-table-head-height: Overrides the header-row height the table measures for itself; the loading scrim insets its top by it, so the spinner sits below the header rather than behind it (falls back to the measured height, then 40px).
--ds-table-head-padding-bottom: Per-side header padding override; falls back to the density value --table-head-pad-y.
--ds-table-head-padding-top: Per-side header padding override; falls back to the density value --table-head-pad-y.
--ds-table-icon-button-color: Icon colour of ds-table's own icon buttons — the row-action kebab and the column picker. Defaults to --icon-default. Neither is a ds-icon-button, so the icon-button tokens do not reach them.
--ds-table-icon-button-color-hover: Hover icon colour for ds-table's row-action kebab and column picker. Defaults to --icon-strong.
--ds-table-icon-button-focus-color: Focus-outline colour for ds-table's row-action kebab and column picker. Defaults to --accent.
--ds-table-min-width: Readability floor on the inner table (default 0 = none). Below it the columns stop shrinking and the wrapper's horizontal scroller takes over, which is what a wide table wants on a narrow screen.
--ds-table-sticky-scrollbar-offset: Where the sticky horizontal scrollbar comes to rest, as any CSS length. Unset, the table measures its scroll container's bottom padding and cancels it, so the bar sits on the edge the reader sees; set this for a scrollport whose reachable edge is somewhere else. Overrides `[stickyScrollbarOffset]` and `DS_CONFIG.table.stickyScrollbarOffset`.
--ds-table-utility-column-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the utility column on both sides, one length (default the cell padding chain: --ds-table-cell-padding-left / -right, then -x). 0 makes the column exactly the button's width.
--ds-table-utility-column-width: Width hint of the trailing column the column picker and the row-actions button ride in (default --space-6, the buttons' own 24px). Cells are border-box, so the rendered column is max(this, button + both paddings); narrow it through --ds-table-utility-column-padding-x.
--ds-tabs-gap: Gap between tabs in the strip.
--ds-tabs-panel-padding-top: Space between the tab strip and its panel.
--ds-tabs-scroll-arrow-bg-color-hover: Hover fill behind a `scrollable` strip's prev/next arrow (defaults to --surface-secondary).
--ds-tabs-scroll-arrow-icon-color-hover: Hover colour of a `scrollable` strip's prev/next chevron (defaults to the active tab label colour: --ds-tab-label-color-active, or --ds-tab-pill-label-color-active in pills).
--ds-tag-hover-label-color: Tag text colour on hover (defaults to --text-primary).
--ds-time-picker-column-height: Max height of each scroll column.
--ds-time-picker-focus-shadow: Time picker trigger focus ring shadow (defaults to --ds-control-focus-shadow).
--ds-time-picker-option-bg-color-selecte: Fill of the selected hour/minute option in the panel (defaults to --accent).
--ds-time-picker-option-text-color-selec: Label colour of the selected option (defaults to --accent-on).
--ds-time-picker-panel-radius: Time panel corner radius (default --radius-lg). Forwarded onto the portaled pane on open.
--ds-time-picker-required-color: Colour of the required asterisk beside the time label (default --error).
--ds-time-picker-trigger-padding-x: Trigger horizontal padding; follows the field family via --field-pad-x, so it tracks density like ds-input.
--ds-time-picker-trigger-radius: Time picker trigger corner radius (defaults to --radius-md).
--ds-time-picker-value-font-family: Font family of the time value (default --font-sans). Set it to --font-mono to pair with a mono date value.
--ds-time-picker-value-font-weight: Weight of the time value (default --font-weight-regular — matches ds-input / ds-select / ds-date-picker).
--ds-toast-bar-color: Toast left accent bar colour (defaults to --accent, per severity).
--ds-toast-enter-keyframes: Toast entrance @keyframes (default ds-fade-in, fading in where the toast stands).
--ds-toast-enter-offset: How far the toast travels in, and from where: positive means it rises from below its resting spot. The default ds-fade-in does not travel, so this applies once --ds-toast-enter-keyframes names a preset that does, such as ds-slide-in (default --space-2).
--ds-toast-icon-color: Toast leading icon colour (defaults to --accent, per severity).
--ds-toast-leave-duration: Toast dismiss duration — a transition, not an animation (default --duration-base).
--ds-toast-max-width: Toast maximum width (default --toast-maxw) — a per-instance hook over the global geometry token.
--ds-toast-min-width: Toast minimum width (default --toast-minw) — a per-instance hook over the global geometry token.
--ds-toast-shift-duration: How long a toast takes to slide to its new place when one is added or removed above it — a re-stack, not a dismissal (default --duration-fast).
--ds-toggle-button-selected-bg-color: Toggle button fill when pressed (defaults to --accent-subtitle).
--ds-toggle-button-selected-border-color: Toggle button border colour when pressed (defaults to --accent).
--ds-toggle-button-selected-color: Toggle button label/icon colour when pressed (defaults to --accent-strong).
--ds-tooltip-border-color: Tooltip border colour, caret included (defaults to --tooltip-border-color).
--ds-tooltip-max-width: Tooltip max width before text wraps (defaults to --tooltip-maxw).
--ds-topbar-crumb-current-text-color: Current breadcrumb colour in the topbar; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-current-label-color.
--ds-topbar-crumb-hover-text-color: Breadcrumb link hover colour in the topbar; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-label-color-hover.
--ds-topbar-crumb-separator-icon-color: Breadcrumb separator colour in the topbar; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-separator-icon-color.
--ds-topbar-crumb-text-color: Breadcrumb link colour in the topbar; unset uses --ds-breadcrumbs-label-color.
--ds-tree-indent: Per-level indent for nested tree rows (defaults to --tree-indent).
--ds-tree-row-selected-icon-color: Icon colour in a selected tree row. Defaults to the row's selected text colour.
--ds-tree-row-selected-text-color: Selected tree row text colour (defaults to --accent-strong).
--ds-w3w-mark-color: what3words leading slash marks colour (defaults to --error).
--ds-waterfall-chart-connector-color: Stroke of the dashed chain that carries each bar's end across to where the next one starts (defaults to --ds-chart-axis-line-color).
--duration-slowest: Longest step: a chart mark growing or drawing on. 0 under reduced motion.
--ease-emphasized: Pick up and put down — overlays.
--ease-emphasized-decelerate: A large mark arriving, long and calm at the end.
--ease-settle: A mark growing into its value; a damped spring that never overshoots.
--error-highlight: Fill behind a range of text marked as in error, with body text over it: the over-limit characters of a soft-limit textarea.
--error-muted-strong: Error muted-strong tint — subtle error fills/backgrounds.
--field-affix-overlap: Prefix/suffix affix bleed over the field border (defaults to --border-width-default).
--field-gap-req: 4px — gap between label and required asterisk.
--field-label-gap: 6px — field vertical rhythm: label↔control and control↔hint.
--field-num-stepper-w: Number input stepper button column width (32px).
--field-pad-y: Form field vertical padding (0 — height set by line-height/min-height instead).
--field-select-pad-r: Select field right padding, clears the chevron icon (32px).
--field-textarea-rows-min: 60px — min-height for inline textarea inside the field wrapper.
--focus-field: Soft outer glow for focused fields (single-layer shadow).
--focus-field-alpha: Field focus halo alpha (boost in dark themes).
--focus-field-error: Soft outer glow for focused fields in error state.
--focus-field-secondary: Field focus glow tinted with the secondary colour.
--focus-field-success: Field focus glow tinted with the success colour.
--focus-field-tertiary: Field focus glow tinted with the tertiary colour.
--focus-field-warning: Field focus glow tinted with the warning colour.
--focus-ring: Default two-layer focus ring shadow (inner ring + outer glow).
--focus-ring-color: Colour of the control focus outline. Follows --accent, so it adapts inside a ds-color zone.
--focus-ring-error: Focus ring shadow for invalid/error controls.
--focus-ring-inner: Separates the two bands of the field halo. Controls draw an outline whose gap is unpainted, so nothing there reads it.
--focus-ring-inset: The focus ring drawn INSIDE the border box, for a subtree under data-focus="inset". Same two rings and colours as --focus-ring; only the direction differs, so an overflow:hidden ancestor cannot clip it away.
--focus-ring-inset-error: The inset ring in the error colour, for a field that is invalid while focused under data-focus="inset".
--focus-ring-inverted: Focus ring shadow for dark/inverted surfaces.
--focus-ring-offset: 2px — gap between element edge and focus outline. The gap is unpainted, so it shows whatever the control sits on. Negative draws the ring inward, past a clipping ancestor.
--focus-ring-radius: The radius of the keyboard focus ring on any focused element that declares no border-radius of its own, in the library and in the app. An outline follows the border-radius of the box it is drawn on, so this is set on the focused element at zero specificity: any radius the element declares wins. An app element with a fill or border and no radius of its own rounds its corners while focused; declare its border-radius to keep it square. Set 0 to make every such ring square. Follows --ds-radius-inner, so retuning the inner radius moves these rings with it.
--focus-ring-secondary: Focus ring shadow tinted with the secondary colour.
--focus-ring-success: Focus ring shadow tinted with the success colour.
--focus-ring-tertiary: Focus ring shadow tinted with the tertiary colour.
--focus-ring-warning: Focus ring shadow tinted with the warning colour.
--focus-ring-width: 2px — thickness of the control focus outline. The WCAG 2.4.13 floor for a perimeter indicator; 1px fails it.
--form-section-label-w: 280px — form section grid labels column width.
--grid-table-min: Grid layout table column min width (220px, showcase).
--hit-xs: The smallest pointer target in the system (24px, WCAG 2.5.8): every icon-only control takes the pointer over at least this, however small it is drawn, and the date picker arrows and the modal close are this size. Raise it, to 44px for a touch screen, and every icon-only control's target follows.
--icon-on-primary: Icon colour for content placed on primary-coloured surfaces.
--layer-base: Stacking context floor — default document layer (0).
--layer-raised: Stacking context for slightly raised surfaces, e.g. cards (1).
--layer-tooltip: Stacking context for tooltips — top of the stack (1600).
--list-item-gap: Gap between list item content parts (16px).
--map-chip-inset: Map chip inset from map edge (12px, showcase).
--matrix-cell-minw: Matrix table cell min width (64px, showcase).
--matrix-cell-pad-x: Matrix table cell horizontal padding (10px, showcase).
--matrix-cell-pad-y: Matrix table cell vertical padding (8px, showcase).
--matrix-maxh: 360px — matrix component max height (shares optical size with --popover-maxh).
--matrix-rowhdr-minw: Matrix table row-header min width (160px, showcase).
--modal-h-fullscreen: Fullscreen modal height — viewport minus gutter (100vh - space-6).
--modal-w-fullscreen: Fullscreen modal width — viewport minus gutter (100vw - space-6).
--opacity-disabled: Full disabled state where opacity is the ONLY signal — a calendar day, a toggle button. A control that already swaps to --text-disabled must not stack this on top.
--opacity-text-disabled: Disabled text where colour token unavailable.
--page-gutter-desktop: Page edge gutter at desktop breakpoint (defaults to --space-5).
--page-gutter-mobile: Page edge gutter at mobile breakpoint (defaults to --space-3).
--page-gutter-tablet: Page edge gutter at tablet breakpoint (defaults to --space-4).
--page-gutter-wide: Page edge gutter at wide breakpoint (defaults to --space-6).
--page-margin-desktop: Page outer margin at desktop breakpoint (defaults to --space-8).
--page-margin-mobile: Page outer margin at mobile breakpoint (defaults to --space-4).
--page-margin-tablet: Page outer margin at tablet breakpoint (defaults to --space-6).
--page-margin-wide: Page outer margin at wide breakpoint (defaults to --space-10).
--picker-maxh: 280px — max height of the listbox panel shared by autocomplete and multi-select.
--picker-offset: 4px — gap between a picker trigger and its listbox panel.
--primary: Primary brand fill (buttons, links, focus ring outer).
--primary-muted-strong: Strongest tint in the brand-muted family.
--primary-pressed: Active / pressed state on brand fill.
--primary-selected-hover: Hover on already-selected brand surfaces (e.g. active sidenav item hover).
--primary-strong: Darker brand for text on brand tints.
--primary-subtitle: Light brand tint (active table row, date range fill).
--radio-bw-checked: Radio ring width when checked (defaults to --border-width-strong).
--radius-flat: Intentionally squared — btn-group middle, in-range datepicker.
--radius-lg: Menus, popovers, cards, modals, drawers, toasts.
--radius-md: Buttons, fields, tooltips, search, segmented, tags.
--radius-sm: kbd, indeterminate-checkbox tick, link focus halo.
--radius-xl: Large containers — viewport / scanner frames, hero cards.
--secondary-muted-strong: Slightly deeper muted secondary surface fill.
--secondary-on: Text/icon colour placed on a secondary-filled surface.
--secondary-strong: Darkened secondary — emphasised text/icons on light surfaces.
--secondary-subtitle: Palest secondary tint — subtitle text on secondary surfaces.
--settings-row-label-gap: 2px — gap between settings row strong label and helper text.
--shadow-tint-l: Shadow lightness — flip in dark mode.
--sidenav-collapsed-glyph: 20px — the icon size the collapsed rail's items render at, and what the alert dot is positioned against so it rides the glyph's corner rather than the tile's.
--sort-ic-gap: 6px — gap between header label and sort icon.
--sort-ic-opacity-idle: 0.4 — sort icon opacity on an unsorted column.
--sort-ic-size: Table header sort icon size (defaults to --icon-xs, 12px).
--space-0-5: Hairline insets, icon close button pad.
--space-inline: Default horizontal gap between inline elements (8px).
--space-stack: Default vertical rhythm between stacked elements (16px).
--statemap-arrow-cap: State-map transition arrow cap size (4px, showcase).
--static-ink: Fixed dark ink — does not respond to theme or scoping (#161A28).
--success-muted-strong: Success muted-strong tint — subtle success fills/backgrounds.
--success-pressed: Success fill, pressed state (darkened toward black).
--surface-muted: Muted neutral chip background (stat icon chip, etc.).
--surface-secondary: Hover lane, table head, addons, code blocks.
--switch-thumb-pad: Switch thumb inset from track edge (2px).
--switch-thumb-travel: Switch thumb slide distance between off/on (16px).
--tab-spec-dot-offset: Browser-tab spec unread-dot offset (defaults to --border-width-strong, showcase).
--tab-spec-maxw: Browser-tab spec example max width (220px, showcase).
--table-sticky-col-z: Table sticky column stacking order (defaults to --layer-raised).
--table-sticky-corner-z: Table sticky header/column corner cell stacking order, above both.
--table-sticky-header-z: Table sticky header stacking order (defaults to --layer-raised).
--tag-pad-x-close: Tag horizontal padding when a close button is present (6px).
--tertiary: Third brand hue — tertiary button fill, tonal chips, indicators.
--tertiary-muted-strong: Tertiary muted-strong tint — subtle tertiary fills/backgrounds.
--tertiary-strong: Darker tertiary for text on tertiary tints.
--text-on-media: Text over photos / camera feeds; pair with --text-on-media-shadow.
--text-on-media-shadow: Text-legibility drop shadow — pair with --text-on-media over photos / camera feeds.
--text-on-warning: Text colour for content placed on a warning-coloured surface.
--tooltip-bg-color: Surface of ds-tooltip and the chart tooltip: --surface-overlay.
--tooltip-text-color: Text of ds-tooltip and the chart tooltip: --text-primary.
--tooltip-border-color: Border of ds-tooltip and the chart tooltip: --border-default, --border-strong on the dark theme.
--warning-muted-strong: Warning muted-strong tint — subtle warning fills/backgrounds.
--warning-pressed: Warning fill, pressed state (darkened toward black).
--ds-toast-queue-bg-color: Background of the `+N` strip shown while toasts wait behind maxVisible (default --surface-overlay).
--ds-toast-queue-text-color: Text colour of the `+N` strip shown while toasts wait behind maxVisible (default --text-secondary).
--ds-line-chart-placeholder-height: Height reserved by a ds-line-chart that has no plot to draw: the loading skeleton, and the empty, error and no-visible-series boxes. Unset, the skeleton and the boxes take the height the plot would take with its axis space; set, all of them take this value and the plot keeps --ds-line-chart-plot-height.
--ds-line-chart-plot-height: Height of the plot coordinate space a ds-line-chart draws its series in (default 240px). Read back as a number, so it takes a px length only.
